FireflyLantern.name: Lantern
FireflyLantern.description:
A light to shine the way, illuminating even the most palpable darkness.

When held, reveal the Aura of Pallets, Vault locations, and the closest Generator. Place your Lantern atop a Generator to reveal its Aura to your teammates.

Item_Camper_AlexsToolbox.name: Alex's Toolbox
Item_Camper_AlexsToolbox.description:
A metal box containing mainly saws and vice grips of varying sizes but also other tools. Even though the content of this Toolbox is clearly aimed at destructive deeds, it can be used to repair various mechanical components as well.

18 charges.Increases repair speed by 10%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 100%.

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

Item_Camper_AnniversaryToolbox.name: Anniversary Toolbox
Item_Camper_AnniversaryToolbox.description:
A toolbox that’s slightly explosive.

32 charges.Increases repair speed by 50%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 50%.Detonates a firework once depleted. Yay!

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

Item_Camper_BeigeMap.name: Scribbled Map
Item_Camper_BeigeMap.description:
Peering at the parchment, a path appears in your mind. Moments later, you feel lost again.

Press the Use Item Button to reveal auras of all pallets and vaults within 32 meters for 12 seconds.Using the secondary interaction creates a beam of light at the Survivor's location. Generators within 32 meters of the beam of light have their auras revealed.5 charges.

Item_Camper_BrokenKey.name: Broken Key
Item_Camper_BrokenKey.description:
The bow and shank of a key, vibrating with power.


Consume a charge to:

Reveal auras of Survivors within 48 meters for 8 seconds by holding the Use Item Button.


Begins with 6 charges.

Item_Camper_CommodiousToolbox.name: Commodious Toolbox
Item_Camper_CommodiousToolbox.description:
A large metal box containing basic tools and extra mechanical parts. Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components.

32 charges.Increases repair speed by 50%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 50%.

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

Item_Camper_ContaminationSerum.name: Vaccine
Item_Camper_ContaminationSerum.description:
A vaccine effective against contamination from the T-Virus.

Limited items are consumed by The Entity at the trial's end.

Item_Camper_DullKey.name: Dull Key
Item_Camper_DullKey.description:
A bent and dull Key that once held great power.


Consume a charge to:

Reveal auras of Survivors within 56 meters for 9 seconds by holding the Use Item Button.Unlock Chests quickly. Chests unlocked with this Key have a revealed aura within 42 meters, enabling another Survivor to rummage once, and will contain items of at least Rare quality.Unlock the Hatch.


Begins with 5 charges.

Item_Camper_EngineerToolbox.name: Engineer's Toolbox
Item_Camper_EngineerToolbox.description:
Metal box with highly specialized tools meant for engineering. Most of the tools can still be used by neophytes to make fast repairs or break various mechanical components.

16 charges.Increases repair speed by 100%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 10%.

Repairing a generator requires 90 charges.

Sabotaging a hook requires 6 charges.

Item_Camper_FadedMap.name: Cryptic Map
Item_Camper_FadedMap.description:
Looking at it, the directions make no sense. But merely holding it grants you an uncanny intuition.

Press the Use Item Button to reveal auras of all pallets and vaults within 24 meters for 10 seconds.Using the secondary interaction creates a beam of light at the Survivor's location. Generators within 32 meters of the beam of light have their auras revealed.4 charges.

Item_Camper_Firecracker_Anniversary2019.name: Third Year Party Starter
Item_Camper_Firecracker_Anniversary2019.description:
A small, highly-explosive dinner table decoration. Detonates into loud bangs, intense light flashes, and playful confetti. Can be used as a distraction, as a blinding device or to celebrate our three years together.

1 charge.

Item_Camper_Firecracker_Chinese.name: Chinese Firecracker
Item_Camper_Firecracker_Chinese.description:
A row of small explosive devices wrapped in heavy paper casing. Detonates into loud bangs and intense light flashes. Can be used as a distraction, as a blinding device or to celebrate.

1 charge.

Item_Camper_Firecracker_Flashbang.name: Flash Grenade
Item_Camper_Firecracker_Flashbang.description:
A hand grenade that creates a large flash of light and a loud sound on detonation.

Limited items are consumed by The Entity at the trial's end.

Item_Camper_Firecracker_WinterEvent.name: Winter Party Starter
Item_Camper_Firecracker_WinterEvent.description:
A small, highly-explosive dinner table decoration. Detonates into loud bangs and intense light flashes. Can be used as a distraction, as a blinding device or to celebrate.

1 charge.

Item_Camper_Flashlight.name: Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight.description:
A standard Flashlight. Can be used to light your way in the darkness.

8 seconds of use.

Item_Camper_Flashlight_Anniversary2020.name: Anniversary Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight_Anniversary2020.description:
A festive Flashlight that explodes with confetti upon blinding a Killer. Surprise!

8 Seconds of use.

Item_Camper_Flashlight_Anniversary2022.name: Masquerade Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight_Anniversary2022.description:
Not even a mask can protect you from this Flashlight's bright beam.

8 Seconds of use.Increases confetti by 100%.

Item_Camper_Flashlight_Anniversary2026.name: Banquet Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight_Anniversary2026.description: It’s time to burn calories...and retinas. 8 seconds of use.

Item_Camper_Flashlight_Random.name: Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight_Random.description: A Flashlight that can cause a distraction or even rescue another Survivor.

Item_Camper_Flashlight02.name: Sport Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight02.description:
A very portable Flashlight with a good grip. Its efficient technology produces a powerful light while consuming less power.

8 Seconds of use.Decreases Flashlight battery consumption by 11%.Increases the accuracy of the Flashlight beam by 20%.

Item_Camper_Flashlight03.name: Utility Flashlight
Item_Camper_Flashlight03.description:
A sturdy but heavy Flashlight that packs a lot of power.

12 Seconds of use.Increases the brightness of the Flashlight beam by 30%.Increases Blindness duration by 15%.Decreases the accuracy of the Flashlight beam by 20%.

Item_Camper_Flashlight04.name: Will O' Wisp
Item_Camper_Flashlight04.description:
A Flashlight equipped with a special lens cover that adds an orange tint and a little ghost to the beam.

8 Seconds of use. Considerably increases Friendly Ghosts in your life.

Item_Camper_JerryCan_Spring2025.name: Blood Can
Item_Camper_JerryCan_Spring2025.description:
The handle is slick, and blood wells between your fingers as you tighten your grip.Found when interacting with the Blood Pump. Required to carry the blood needed to repair Blood Generators.

Carry capacity of 40 liters.Produces a pool of blood when running.Generates distinct noises while being carried.Noises vary depending on movement speed and number of liters being carried.Blood leaks from the Blood Can when running or if it is left on the ground.Killers can stomp the Blood Can while on the ground, spilling more blood.Vanishes from the trial when empty.

Item_Camper_K29InfectionRemover.name: First Aid Spray
Item_Camper_K29InfectionRemover.description:
A medication that helps reverse the effects of Uroboros infection.

Limited items are consumed by The Entity at the trial's end.

Item_Camper_Key.name: Skeleton Key
Item_Camper_Key.description:
A tarnished and crooked key, vibrating with ominous power.


Consume a charge to:

Reveal auras of Survivors within 64 meters for 10 seconds by holding the Use Item Button.Unlock Chests quickly. Chests unlocked with this Key have a revealed aura within 42 meters, enabling another Survivor to rummage once, and will contain items of at least Rare quality.Unlock the Hatch.

Item_Camper_Key_Random.name: Skeleton Key
Item_Camper_Key_Random.description: A Key that can unlock the hatch.

Item_Camper_LunarToolbox.name: Festive Toolbox
Item_Camper_LunarToolbox.description:
A Toolbox packed to the brim with fireworks, it's prepared to celebrate all your life’s successes... and failures.

32 charges.Increases repair speed by 50%.Unlocks the sabotage action.Increases sabotage speed by 50%.Great Skill Checks detonate a small cluster of firecrackers.Failed Skill Checks detonate fireworks.

Item_Camper_Map_Random.name: Cryptic Map
Item_Camper_Map_Random.description: A Map that can reveal the aura of various objects.

Item_Camper_Map_Spring2024.name: Bloodsense Map
Item_Camper_Map_Spring2024.description:
A bloodstained piece of parchment, hastily rolled and burning with a strange power.

Generators within 32 meters of the beam of light have their auras revealed.Causes pools of blood to spawn beneath you while being used.8 charges.

Item_Camper_MedKit_Random.description: A Medkit that can heal others faster or yourself.

The sketch is clear and detailed. Strange knowledge flows into you, followed by dread uncertainty.

Item_Camper_VoidBomb_Halloween2024.description:
Cold to the touch, the crystal vibrates from the force contained within.1 charge.

When shattered, the Void Crystal releases thick smoke with an expanding radius of up to 4 meters.Survivors within 6 meters of the smoke do not leave scratch marks.The smoke dissipates 8 seconds after reaching it maximum size.

A pocket mirror pulled from the basement's White Glyph. Its surface is frosty.

Item_Survivor_CalamariContaminationAntid.description: A potent formula that reverses the effects of both the T-Virus and Uroboros Infection. Limited items are consumed by The Entity at the trial's end.
